headline: ICICI Prudential launches Nifty Pharma ETF New Fund Offer
hook: New passive avenue for healthcare sector exposure
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund has announced the launch of its Nifty Pharma ETF, providing investors with passive exposure to pharmaceutical stocks in India. The New Fund Offer (NFO) details include minimum investment thresholds and structural fund specifics. Retail investors looking to diversify their portfolios into healthcare without stock-specific risk can evaluate this thematic option. The fund tracks the Nifty Pharma Index, capturing the performance of leading pharmaceutical companies listed on the NSE.
whats_next: Watch for NFO closing dates and fund listing details
why_it_matters: New thematic ETF option for your healthcare sector allocation

headline: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund launches a new contra fund NFO
hook: New contrarian bet from ICICI Prudential
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund has announced the launch of a new contra fund New Fund Offer (NFO). The fund aims to follow a contrarian investment strategy, buying out-of-favour stocks and sectors with turnaround potential. Investors looking to diversify their portfolio into value-driven equity strategies can evaluate this new offering. The NFO period and specific investment terms are available through the fund house or authorized distributors.
why_it_matters: New equity fund offering for your portfolio diversification
